content.title: About
content.content: The Whopper Jr with cheese is a smaller version of Burger King’s classic Whopper, topped with melted cheese. It includes a 71 g beef patty, sesame seed bun, a slice of processed cheese, pickles, fresh tomato, lettuce, onion and the signature sauce. Served hot and ready to eat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Whopper Jr was first introduced in the 1990s as a compact alternative to the original Whopper.
The cheese used is typically a processed American cheese that melts in seconds.
Although often part of kids’ combo meals, the burger is popular with adults looking for a smaller portion.
In several countries Burger King offers local twists on the Whopper Jr, adding bacon or regional spices.
The Whopper Jr with cheese contains roughly 340 kcal, making it less caloric than the full‑size Whopper.

items.title: Protein
items.content: The beef patty provides about 14 g of protein, essential for muscle repair and satiety.

items.title: Iron
items.content: Red meat is a good source of heme iron, which is readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: The melted cheese adds a modest amount of calcium, supporting bone health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meat and the bun contain B6 and B12 vitamins, important for nervous system function and metabolism.

items.title: Dietary fiber from vegetables
items.content: Tomato, lettuce and onion contribute a small amount of fiber that aids digestion.

items.title: High sodium
items.content: The sauce and cheese can add a notable amount of salt, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Beef and processed cheese contain saturated fats that, in excess, can raise cholesterol levels.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Cheese contains dairy proteins and the bun contains gluten; individuals with allergies should be cautious.

items.title: Caloric content
items.content: Despite its smaller size, the burger still provides about 340 kcal, which can affect daily energy balance.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The Whopper Jr with cheese is designed to be eaten by hand. It can be split in half for smaller bites or topped with extra sauce to taste. It pairs well with fries and a cold beverage.

content.title: Storage
content.content: The burger is best consumed immediately after preparation. If needed, store it in the refrigerator for up to 2 hours, wrapped in foil or plastic wrap to retain moisture. Reheat in a microwave for 30‑40 seconds or in an oven at 150 °C.
